=== FILE: 0 What Pragmatism Means.md ===
# 0 What Pragmatism Means

The pragmatic method is primarily a method of settling metaphysical disputes that otherwise might be interminable. Is the world one or many?--fated or free?--material or spiritual?--here are notions either of which may or may not hold good of the world; and disputes over such notions are unending. The pragmatic method in such cases is to try to interpret each notion by tracing its respective practical consequences. What difference would it practically make to anyone if this notion rather than that notion were true? If no practical difference whatever can be traced, then the alternatives mean practically the same thing, and all dispute is idle. Whenever a dispute is serious, we ought to be able to show some practical difference that must follow from one side or the other's being right.

Dangling-reference repairs: none needed.

- "such notions" (statement 2) and "such cases" (statement 3) both point back to the list of disputed alternatives in statement 2, which the note keeps. They don't dangle.
- "this notion rather than that notion" (statement 4) and "the alternatives" (statement 5) point back to "each notion" in statement 3, which the note keeps.

Generic "we"/"you", left unrepaired:

- "we ought to be able to show" (statement 6) is generic "we": anyone party to a serious dispute.

Dropped statements:

- The squirrel anecdote, dropped in full as illustration. This covers the camping-party narrative, the statement of the problem ("DOES THE MAN GO ROUND THE SQUIRREL OR NOT?"), the scholastic adage, James's quoted distinction between the two practical senses of "going round", and the closing reaction ("Altho one or two of the hotter disputants…"). It is a story whose point the method paragraph restates in general form, so no argument is lost.
- "I tell this trivial anecdote because it is a peculiarly simple example of what I wish now to speak of as THE PRAGMATIC METHOD." This was dropped as a transition that only ties the story to the method. The term "the pragmatic method" is introduced self-sufficiently by the next kept sentence.
